name: Math Canvas
description: A dark slate for maths: an equation written in an elegant italic serif, a yellow box and handwritten note on the key term, and a graph whose curve plots itself to scale with a glowing dot and a live value, beside a dashed comparison line.
best_use_cases: Maths explainers with a live-plotted graph
Equations that write themselves term by term
style: Dark slate with faint grid; Instrument Serif italic equations, teal main curve, yellow key-term box and handwritten notes.
